rules.quote: Invalid file format (e.g. PDF, txt).

rules.title: GeoJSON object is malformed

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
RFC 7946, section 3

rules.quote: A GeoJSON geometry object of any type other than "GeometryCollection" must have a member with the name "coordinates".

rules.title: Top level is not a FeatureCollection

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Examples

rules.fix: Wraps the geometry or Feature in a FeatureCollection, as in the Commission's examples.

rules.title: Member not defined by GeoJSON

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 6.1

rules.fix: Drops the member from the output; properties are kept.

rules.title: Bounding box member present

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 5

rules.fix: Drops "bbox", which would be stale after repairs.

rules.title: Legacy "crs" member naming WGS 84

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 4

rules.fix: Drops the member; RFC 7946 coordinates are always WGS 84 longitude, latitude.

rules.title: Coordinates declared in a reference system other than WGS 84

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Introduction
RFC 7946, section 4

rules.quote: If the geocoordinates available to the Economic Operator are in another coordinates system, these must be converted to the WGS84 (EPSG:4326) coordinate system with longitude and latitude units of decimal degrees.

rules.title: Plot has no geometry

sources.cite: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Article 9(1), point (d)
Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Annex II, point 3

rules.quote: the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities that the relevant product contains, or has been made using, were produced

rules.title: Geometry type is not accepted

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 5
EUDR Information System, DDS V4 API reference, DdsProducerType, geometryGeojson

rules.quote: Please note that geometry types of "LineString" and "MultiLineString" do not represent valid geocoordinate shapes for declaring production places and will not be accepted/processed.

rules.title: Geometry has no positions

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Article 2, point (28)

rules.quote: MultiPoint geometry types consist of two or more points (coordinate pairs).

rules.title: GeometryCollection inside a GeometryCollection

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 3.1.8

rules.quote: To maximize interoperability, implementations SHOULD avoid nested GeometryCollections.
rules.fix: Flattens the nested collection into its parent.

rules.title: Multi-part geometry with one part

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
RFC 7946, section 3.1.8

rules.quote: MultiPolygon: MultiPolygon geometry types contain two or more polygon definitions.
rules.fix: Replaces it with the single Point, Polygon or geometry it contains.

rules.title: Position is not an array of at least two numbers

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
RFC 7946, section 3.1.1

rules.quote: A position is represented by an array of numbers. There must be at least two elements and may be more. The order of elements must follow longitude, latitude

rules.title: Longitude or latitude out of range

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 11
EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation invalid coordinates"

rules.quote: Invalid coordinate range (outside the value ranges 90/-90 or 180/-180).

rules.title: Position has more than two values

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
RFC 7946, section 11.2

rules.fix: Keeps longitude and latitude and drops the extra values, which the plot location does not need.

rules.title: More than six decimal places

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Important notes for users of the EUDR IS
EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation invalid coordinates"

rules.quote: The information system will truncate coordinate points to 6 decimal places before storing. It is superfluous/wasteful to send a higher resolution, and may, in extreme cases, even result in invalid geometries where the original is valid.
rules.fix: Truncates every coordinate to six decimal places, exactly as the Information System does, and checks the result.

rules.title: Fewer than six decimal places

sources.cite: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Article 2, point (28)

rules.quote: ‘geolocation’ means the geographical location of a plot of land described by means of latitude and longitude coordinates corresponding to at least one latitude and one longitude point and using at least six decimal digits

rules.title: Polygon ring is not closed

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 4
RFC 7946, section 3.1.6

rules.quote: "Open" polygons. All polygons must represent closed shapes (i.e. the 1st coordinate pair same as the last)
rules.fix: Appends the first position to close the ring.

rules.title: Polygon ring has fewer than four positions

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
RFC 7946, section 3.1.6

rules.quote: Polygon: Polygon geometry types consist of at least four pairs of coordinates and represent an enclosed area by these coordinate points.

rules.title: Same position twice in a row

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 7

rules.quote: Duplicate coordinates due to 6 decimals rounding in the system
rules.fix: Removes the repeated position.

rules.title: Ring doubles back on itself (overlapping sides)

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 2

rules.quote: Overlapping sides
rules.fix: Removes the vertex at the tip of the spike; the enclosed area does not change.

rules.title: Ring encloses no area (all positions on one line)

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 6

rules.quote: Coordinates representing straight lines.

rules.title: Ring crosses or touches itself

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 1
EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation invalid geometry"

rules.quote: Important note: Polygons with holes (i.e., doughnut shapes) and shapes with crossing lines (like a figure eight for example) are not supported and will not be processed.

rules.title: Polygon has a hole

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions
EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, items 3 and 15

rules.quote: If a doughnut shape is needed, it can be defined by combining two half-doughnut shaped polygons.

rules.title: Parts of a MultiPolygon overlap or share a side

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation invalid geometry"

rules.quote: The geolocation data cannot contain invalid geometry (for ex, invalid polygons).

rules.title: Ring winding differs from the right-hand rule

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 3.1.6

rules.quote: A linear ring MUST follow the right-hand rule with respect to the area it bounds, i.e., exterior rings are counterclockwise, and holes are clockwise.
rules.fix: Reverses the ring. RFC 7946 also says parsers SHOULD NOT reject the other order, and the Commission's documents do not require one.

rules.title: Polygon crosses the 180th meridian

sources.cite: RFC 7946, section 3.1.9
RFC 7946, section 3.1.1

rules.quote: Any geometry that crosses the antimeridian SHOULD be represented by cutting it in two such that neither part's representation crosses the antimeridian.
rules.fix: Cuts the polygon at 180° into a MultiPolygon when both parts are valid; otherwise leaves it for manual repair.

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation area for point"

rules.title: Property name in the wrong letter case

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 9

rules.quote: Invalid property names (e.g. "geometry" or incorrect property keyword case – "productionplace" instead of "ProductionPlace").
rules.fix: Renames the property to the exact name, when that name is not already used.

rules.quote: It is recommended to provide the optional GeoJSON property "ProductionPlace" in the generated geocoordinates files for importing into the system.

rules.title: Properties the Information System ignores

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Definitions

rules.quote: Any other properties that are syntactically valid but not included in the optional properties list above, will be ignored.
rules.fix: With --strip-unknown-properties, removes them.

rules.title: Area is not a number

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 14

rules.quote: For example, "Area": "3" instead of "Area": 3 will result in area = 0 because the value 3 in quotes is not recognized as a number which is what is expected.
rules.fix: Converts a text value that is a plain decimal number (for example "3" or "2.5") to a number.

rules.title: Point plot without Area

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation area for point"
EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Important notes for users of the EUDR IS

rules.quote: In case a point is provided for a geolocation, the area is mandatory. If the user provided no data, the value 4 (ha) is introduced by default for the area.

rules.title: Point Area below 0.0001 ha

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation area for point"

rules.quote: When provided, the area must also be higher or equal to 0.0001ha.

rules.title: Point used for a plot of more than 4 ha

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation area for point"
Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Article 2, point (28)

rules.quote: If the commodity is not cattle and the user provided a value higher than 4ha then the system will raise an error.

rules.title: Area property differs from the polygon's computed area

sources.cite: Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Article 9(1), point (d)

rules.title: Geolocation data larger than the Information System accepts

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation data size"
EUDR Information System, GeoJSON File Description, Common GeoJSON file errors, item 16
Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3084 as amended by (EU) 2026/1565, Article 8a (grouping)

rules.quote: The total size of geolocation data per DDS cannot exceed a certain amount (presently set to 25Mb).
rules.fix: `plotline split` divides the file into parts within the limit, one per statement; the statements can then be grouped.

rules.title: More producers than one commodity entry accepts

sources.cite: EUDR Information System, API and UI Validation Rules, "Geolocation Producers information"

rules.quote: The total number of producers data per commodity cannot exceed a certain amount (presently set to 1000). The total number of producers data per DDS cannot exceed a certain amount (presently set to 10,000).
rules.fix: `plotline split --max-producers` divides the file by producer.

rules.title: Same geometry appears more than once
rules.fix: Removes later copies whose geometry and properties are both identical; copies with different properties are left for you to decide.
